observations: Two black plastic power banks lying on a concrete floor.
The top power bank has a yellowish piece of paper or tape covering its front surface.
Both power banks have charging cables attached; one is green, the other blue.
The cables appear to be braided or reinforced plastic.
The power banks are shown from the top and side, but the bottom and rear are not visible.
The image quality is low, and the background is blurry.

claims.evidence: The item is a generic power bank, but its condition and value as scrap depend on the battery capacity and health, which cannot be determined from a photo.
The location is not confirmed by the photo.

risks.risk: The power banks may not hold a charge or may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the battery voltage or a photo of the battery terminals.

risks.risk: The capacity (mAh) is unknown, which determines the value.
risks.proof: A photo of the specification sticker on the back of the power bank.

risks.risk: The cables may be damaged or have poor connectors.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cable connectors and a video of the cables being plugged in.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification sticker on the back of the power banks.
Video showing the battery voltage with a multimeter.
Close-up photo of the cable connectors.
Photo of the bottom of the power banks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
